title: The Wedding People
description: As narrator, the terrific Laser, an actress and puppeteer, only enhances the swoon-worthy quirks and romance. - Vulture A Today show #ReadwithJenna Book Club Pick, A Goodreads Choice Awards 2024 Winner, and long-listed in many Best of the Year 2024 picks!
